title_zh: 时代少年团：新一代的青春偶像组合
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (14/20): Teens in Times, a New Generation of Teen Idols
note_en: 为了 introduces a purpose and comes before the main action: 为了给年轻观众带来活力，他们常常在明亮的舞台灯光下表演整齐的舞蹈 "to bring energy to their young audiences, they often perform synchronized dances under bright stage lights." English can put the purpose at either end ("They dance... to bring energy"), but in Chinese the 为了 clause normally comes first, followed by what is done to achieve it.
